fml.menu.mods.info.description.headinaja: Take your head off and live in a life-support jar: drive your own headless body over a neuro-link, borrow mob bodies, build mecha, splice genes and put jarred heads to work.
jei.headinajar.separation_chair: Load a Life Support Jar, Relay Goggles, a Collar Cam and four Cranial Saline, and store 40 kFE in it from a Galvanic Pile or Leyden Jar touching it. Sit down and hold Sign on Form 27-B: it takes your head off and leaves your body linked to it. Sneak and use it to open its panel without sitting.
jei.headinajar.life_support_cradle: Holds your head while you walk your body, and a docked head uses no saline. Each second the Cradle refills your saline from its tank, moves up to 10 kFE into your charge and uses 100 FE; every 10 seconds it mends a point of glass. It does not extend the link.
jei.headinajar.saline_mixer: 1,000 mB of water, a sugar, a kelp and a redstone, with 2,000 FE over 10 seconds, make 1,000 mB of Cranial Saline. Water goes in by bucket or pipe. Glass bottles in its slot are filled at 250 mB each; an empty bucket takes a bucketful.
jei.headinajar.body_printer: Prints a new headless body for a head in a jar, in 60 seconds. A print takes 16 rotten flesh, 8 bone blocks, 4 redstone blocks, 8 slime balls, 2,000 mB of saline (by bucket or bottle) and 200 kFE stored before it starts. Load it before you need it, and press Print as the jar.
jei.headinajar.surgical_saw: Use on a creature below 25% health: its body becomes a host. With an empty jar in the other hand you keep its head instead.
jei.headinajar.assembly_gantry: Put a frame and modules in, then Assemble (10,000 FE). Take Apart pulls a mecha back into the slots; Repair spends Mecha Plating.
jei.headinajar.centrifuge: Spins a Blood Sample into a DNA Fraction and a Plasma Vial. Dragon's breath gives Ender Dragon DNA.
jei.headinajar.dna_sequencer: Reads a DNA Fraction into your gene library, a share at a time. Auto takes 10 s at 60% accuracy; calling the twelve bases yourself is instant, 50 to 100% by how many you get right. Each read costs 4,000 FE.
jei.headinajar.gene_splicer: Splices up to three library genes (at least 30% read) into a Serum Cassette with Bio-Gel, a glass bottle and an optional catalyst.
jei.headinajar.injection_rig: Injects the serum in its slot into your own body (with your head on, or linked).
jei.headinajar.leech_jar: Takes a small blood sample every 30 s from a creature standing next to it.
jei.headinajar.syringe: Use on a living creature to draw a Blood Sample. Healthier creatures give better quality.
jei.headinajar.serum_cassette: Made at the Gene Splicer. Use it on a host or on a mecha with a Gene Port, or load it into an Injection Rig.
jei.headinajar.turret_pedestal: Fit a Jarred Head: it guards 16 blocks around the way that mob fights. Skeleton, Stray and Bogged heads need arrows in a chest below or beside it. Power: 1 FE/t on watch, 10 FE/t with a target.
jei.headinajar.cerebral_array: Up to nine jarred heads make FE from Nutrient Broth. Five or more hold a Board Meeting (+10%).
jei.headinajar.employee_mount: Hang a jarred villager on a machine: their profession gives that machine a bonus, for an emerald a day.
jei.headinajar.neural_socket: Plug your jar in to drive six redstone channels, or let a mob head run a program.
jei.headinajar.entangled_pair: Use it to split it into two shards. Craft one with your goggles and the other with your Collar Cam: the link then crosses dimensions.
jei.headinajar.emp_grenade: Throw it: links break (unless shielded), jars and mecha lose power, turrets go dark.
jei.headinajar.jarred_head: A mob's head in a jar, from the Surgical Saw with an empty jar in your off hand. A placed villager keeps trading. Heads work in Turret Pedestals, the Cerebral Array and Neural Sockets; villagers also on an Employee Mount.
jei.headinajar.frame: Assemble it at the Assembly Gantry with modules in the slots of the right kind.

book.headinajar.written.1:
Noggin & Sons
EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK

The opening chapters.

The full handbook, with every department, comes with the Patchouli mod. Lost this copy? A book and a Surgical Steel Blend make another.
book.headinajar.written.2:
WELCOME

Congratulations on joining Head Office. This handbook covers what an employee needs, from the Separation Chair to keeping your head topped up with Cranial Saline.
book.headinajar.written.3: Start with Surgical Steel: smelt a blend of iron, bone meal and coal. Then make Neuro-Copper Wire, a Lens and a Servo. Power comes from a Galvanic Pile fed with meat or rotten flesh.
book.headinajar.written.4:
THE SEPARATION CHAIR

Load the chair with a Life Support Jar, Relay Goggles, a Collar Cam and four bottles of Cranial Saline, and give it 40 kFE. Sit down and hold Sign on Form 27-B.
book.headinajar.written.5: You may get up until the cut. After that, DOLORES will finish what she started. A worn blade can botch the job: keep a Replacement Blade handy.
book.headinajar.written.6:
THE NEURO-LINK

After the cut you walk around in your own headless body and see through the Collar Cam. Your head wears the goggles and sends the signal. The further apart they are, the worse the picture.
book.headinajar.written.7: Water, rock, storms, portals and the Warden all hurt the signal. At zero for five seconds you wake up in your head. Press %s to swap between body and head yourself.
book.headinajar.written.8: Carry your head in a Head Satchel for a perfect link, or dock it in a Life Support Cradle. Relay Masts pass the signal along: masts reach each other and your body within their radius.
book.headinajar.written.9:
WHEN IT GOES WRONG

If your body dies, it becomes a corpse that keeps your things, and you wake up in your head. As a jar, use a Suture Kit on the corpse to get back into it, or print a new body.
book.headinajar.written.10: If your head is destroyed while you are out walking, that is a real death. Guard it. A Signal Jammer near your enemies works wonders.
book.headinajar.written.11:
GETTING HOME

Walk too far and the link breaks: you wake up in your head. A jar with the Wheels module drives at half walking speed: press %s. Without wheels the same key tips the jar on its side to roll, very slowly.
book.headinajar.written.12: Stranded anyway? Press Courier in the jar menu. A Noggin & Sons courier delivers your body to your head in 30 seconds, from anywhere, for 20 kFE of charge (or all you have, if less). Then press %s.

memo.headinajar.mecha_built: Your mecha is on the pad. Swap to your jar (%1$s) and use the mecha to climb in. To get out: hold %2$s and %3$s.

jei.headinajar.galvanic_pile: Burns fuel into 20 FE/t and gives it to the machines touching it. Rotten flesh gives 4,000 FE, a spider eye 6,000 and raw meat or fish 3,000. Use fuel on it, or put it in with a hopper.
jei.headinajar.leyden_jar: Stores 250 kFE. It fills from a power source beside it and feeds its other neighbours at up to 2,000 FE/t. Two Leyden Jars do not feed each other.
jei.headinajar.tesla_node: Sends up to 2,000 FE/t to a linked node up to 16 blocks away, losing 5%. Link two with a Surgical Wrench, the sending node first. The receiving node feeds the machines touching it.
jei.headinajar.surgical_wrench: Links Tesla Nodes: use the sending node, then the receiving one. Sneak and use the sending node to unlink it.
jei.headinajar.charging_dock: Charges a jar standing on it at up to 500 FE/t from the 20 kFE it holds. Your head, set down on it while you walk your body, charges too. Feed it from a Galvanic Pile, a Leyden Jar or a cable.
jei.headinajar.replacement_blade: Use it on the Separation Chair while it is idle: blade wear goes back to 0. A blade over 80% worn can botch a cut.
jei.headinajar.glass_patch: Mends 5 points of Jar Integrity. Use it on your placed head, or put it in the jar menu's feed slot.
jei.headinajar.saline_bottle: Keeps a head alive: 250 mB a bottle. Use it on your placed head, or put it in the jar menu's feed slot. The Separation Chair takes four.
jei.headinajar.cranial_saline_bucket: 1,000 mB of Cranial Saline, taken from a Saline Mixer with an empty bucket. It fills a Life Support Cradle or a Body Printer.
jei.headinajar.life_support_jar: Load it into the Separation Chair: your head lives in it. 3 module slots, 100 kFE of charge, 1,000 mB of saline and 10 points of glass.
jei.headinajar.compact_life_support_jar: The same as a Life Support Jar, head-sized: your head faces the front and the whole jar turns with it. Craft either kind alone to get the other.
jei.headinajar.reinforced_life_support_j: 5 module slots, 250 kFE of charge, 1,500 mB of saline and 20 points of glass. Load it into the Separation Chair instead of a plain jar.
jei.headinajar.executive_life_support_ja: 7 module slots, 500 kFE of charge, 2,000 mB of saline and 30 points of glass. Load it into the Separation Chair instead of a plain jar.
jei.headinajar.manipulator_arm: A jar module. Without it a jar cannot mine, place, fight, use items or pick things up. Each block broken or placed and each hit costs 200 FE of charge.
jei.headinajar.relay_mast: Passes the neuro-link on: from your head within goggle range, to other masts and to your body within 96 blocks. Each mast costs 3% of the signal. Needs 1 FE a tick from a powered neighbour.
jei.headinajar.relay_mast_mk2: A Relay Mast with a 192-block radius. The same 1 FE a tick.
jei.headinajar.signal_jammer: Cuts the neuro-link of anyone within 16 blocks to 30%, except its owner and the players they trust. Needs 4 FE a tick.
jei.headinajar.body_locker: Use it to store the nearest host body within 3 blocks; nothing rots inside. Use it again to let it out in front. Takes robot shells and your own mecha too.
jei.headinajar.safety_placard: Hangs on a wall. Use it to change the notice: there are twelve.
jei.headinajar.neural_lace: Use it on a host body at 50% sync or more: it never rots again.
jei.headinajar.embalming_fluid: Use it on a host body: fresh again, and it rots at half speed for a day.
jei.headinajar.board_room_core: Goes in the Cerebral Array's tenth slot. It lets one Dragon Head sit in the Array, making 300 FE/t.
jei.headinajar.quantum_knot: A part. It goes into the Entangled Pair and the Quantum Goggles.
jei.headinajar.plasma_vial: Comes out of the Centrifuge with each DNA Fraction. It makes Bio-Gel and Gene Wash, and fuels a mecha's Bio-Reactor Core from the Cargo Hold.
jei.headinajar.precision_syringe: Draws Blood Samples of quality 60 to 90, without hurting the creature. Bosses still need a Leviathan Needle.
jei.headinajar.lunk_chassis: Place it, then use it as a jar to climb in. A strong, slow robot body with 60 HP that tosses what it looks at. Runs on the jar's charge.
jei.headinajar.rover_chassis: Place it, then use it as a jar to climb in. A fast robot body; sneak-use it to open its 9-slot hold. Runs on the jar's charge.
jei.headinajar.spider_walker_chassis: Place it, then use it as a jar to climb in. A robot body that climbs walls, takes no fall damage and shoots webs. Runs on the jar's charge.
jei.headinajar.body_recall_beacon: A jar module. While you are a jar, your standing body walks to you, 10 FE a tick, in the same dimension and a loaded chunk. It stops at lava, fire and big drops.
jei.headinajar.suture_kit: Puts your head back on. Carrying your own head, hold use for 3 seconds; as a jar, use it on your body or corpse. Modules and an empty jar come back.
book.headinajar.written2.title:
Employee Handbook
Second Edition

Noggin & Sons
Head Office

The same handbook as the one with pictures, which comes with Patchouli. The next page lists the chapters: click one to go there.

Lost it? A book and a Surgical Steel Blend make another.
book.headinajar.written2.orientation.wel:
Welcome to Head Office. Noggin & Sons takes your head off, keeps it alive in a jar and lets your body walk on without it.

This handbook is issued on your first day. Lost it? A book and a Surgical Steel Blend make another.

• Smelt Surgical Steel.
• Build a Galvanic Pile; fuel it.
• Make 4 Cranial Saline.
• Build and load the Separation Chair.
• Sit, sign, collect your head.

The Shopping List says what to bring.
book.headinajar.written2.orientation.sho: One operation, satchel included: 29 iron, 24 bone meal, 24 coal, 14 copper, 21 redstone, 19 glass, 4 amethyst shards, 8 leather, 2 string, 3 white wool, 1 slime ball, 2 kelp, 2 sugar, 11 rotten flesh, wood and stone.

Far from home:
• amethyst: a geode
• slime ball: a swamp
• kelp: the sea

No Nether trip is needed. Ten of the rotten flesh are fuel for the chair's 40 kFE.

24 ingots, each one Blend: iron, bone meal, coal.

DOLORES notes: receipts in triplicate.
book.headinajar.written2.orientation.how:
Keys show as you bound them: the jar menu is %1$s.

JEI shows recipes; Jade reads bodies, hosts and mecha. Use a pile or power block empty-handed to see its charge.

Advancements are your to-do list.

Two controls on one key? Another mod may share it: the key shows in red on the Options, Controls screen. Rebind one of the two there. The ability key and sprint may share a key on purpose; the game says so the first time.
book.headinajar.written2.orientation.uni:
FE: energy.
kFE: 1,000 FE.
FE/t: FE per tick; 20 ticks make a second.
mB: a thousandth of a bucket. A bottle of saline is 250 mB.

All times are real time.

DOLORES notes: one head per employee.
book.headinajar.written2.facilities.galv: The first generator: 20 FE/t, stores 50 kFE.

Use fuel on it, or hopper it in. FE per item:
• rotten flesh 4,000
• spider eye 6,000
• raw meat or fish 3,000

Cooked food will not burn. It powers any machine touching it: 10 rotten flesh give the chair its 40 kFE in 100 s.
book.headinajar.written2.facilities.shar: Power flows from a Galvanic Pile, Leyden Jar or Tesla Node into every machine touching any face, shared evenly. Machines do not pass it on: put the source against the machine. FE cables from other mods work too.

A Leyden Jar stores 250 kFE. It fills from a source beside it and feeds its other neighbours, 2,000 FE/t; two do not feed each other.

A Tesla Node sends up to 2,000 FE/t to a node within 16 blocks, losing 5%%.

To link two nodes, hold a Surgical Wrench: use the sending node, then the receiving one. Sneak and use the sender to unlink.

The source goes against the sender; the receiver feeds what touches it.
book.headinajar.written2.facilities.char: Charges a jar standing on it, 500 FE/t, from the 20 kFE it holds.

In your body, set your head on it from the Head Satchel: it charges there too.

Feed it from a source beside it. A pile alone gives 20 FE/t; a Leyden Jar keeps it stocked.

DOLORES notes: wipe your jar first.
book.headinajar.written2.life_support.sa: Made by hand, two bottles of 250 mB each. The chair wants four.

A jar holds 1,000 mB. Your head uses 1 mB per 12 s while you are the jar or it is set down: 3 h 20 min a full jar. In the Head Satchel or a Cradle, none.

Top up: use a bottle on your placed head, or the jar menu's feed slot.

The Saline Mixer: 1,000 mB of water, a sugar, a kelp, a redstone and 2,000 FE make 1,000 mB in 10 s. Water by bucket or pipe.

It fills glass bottles in its slot. An empty bucket takes a bucketful, for Cradle and Printer.
book.headinajar.written2.life_support.in:
Integrity is the glass: 10 points. As the jar, damage takes glass first, then health. A placed head is only glass: at 0 it breaks. Players cannot harm it; fire and lava crack a point a second.
No saline: a point lost per 30 s.
Mends 5 points: use it on your placed head, or the feed slot.
book.headinajar.written2.life_support.cr: A head in it uses no saline. It does not extend the link. Fill it by bottle or bucket.

Each second it refills a docked head's saline, moves up to 10 kFE of charge and uses 100 FE; every 10 s it mends a point of glass.
To dock, use it with your head in the Head Satchel; again to take it out. As the jar: use it, then Swap.
book.headinajar.written2.life_support.bo: A new body, Collar Cam fitted, in 60 s, for 16 rotten flesh, 8 bone blocks, 4 redstone blocks, 8 slime balls, 2,000 mB of saline and 200 kFE stored first.

Load it before you need it: when you do, you are a jar and your things are on your corpse. Saline goes in by bucket or bottle. From a pile alone, 200 kFE take over 8 min.

Then, as the jar, press Print. Use the new body, or Swap, to step in.
book.headinajar.written2.separation.the_: The tray slides out to its left. Keep that side, the front and the top clear.

• a Life Support Jar
• Relay Goggles
• a Collar Cam
• 4 Cranial Saline
• 40 kFE, from a pile or Leyden Jar touching it

Load them in its panel; sneak and use the chair to open it without sitting.

Use it to sit; hold Sign for 2 s. It takes 12 s; in the first 5 you may get up, keeping the parts, losing 10 kFE.

Your head goes on the tray (or an empty Cradle within 3 blocks). To carry it, use it with a Head Satchel in your inventory.
Range 48 blocks; Mk II 160, Mk III 640. Use new ones on your placed or docked head.
Bolted to your neck: your body sees through it.

Incident 0017: Oopsie

Each operation adds 5%% blade wear. Over 80%%, a cut may botch: 10%% at 85, 40%% at 100.
A botch flips your view for 30 s and bends the Collar Cam: -10%% range, for good.

Resets an idle chair's wear to 0.

DOLORES notes: so shiny.

Linked, you walk your body and see through the Collar Cam. The bar shows LINK %%, delay, which end you are and the distance.

Signal is full to half the goggles' range, 0 at the range. Your head in the Head Satchel gives 100%%.

Water, deep rock, thunder, portals and Darkness weaken it. Under 20%%, clicks get lost; 5 s at 0%% and you wake in your head.

The swap key, %1$s, takes your body to head always, but head to body only over 20%%.
book.headinajar.written2.separation.when:
FROM: DOLORES
TO: All Staff
RE: Drying Out

Out of saline, a placed head loses 1 glass per 30 s; at 0 glass it is a real death. A full jar lasts 3 h 20 min, then 5 min of warnings.

Not a death: losing the link, or your body dying (a corpse keeps your things).

Real death: your placed head breaking or drying while you walk, or dying as the jar. Modules drop; you respawn with a head.
book.headinajar.written2.jar.no_hands.1:
FROM: DOLORES
TO: All Staff
RE: Hands

Without a Manipulator Arm a jar cannot mine, place, fight, use items or pick things up. Doors and chests do not answer.
book.headinajar.written2.jar.no_hands.2:
A bare jar can still:
• use every Noggin & Sons machine
• step back into its own body
• board a boat or minecart
• ride a host
• use its keys and modules
• pick up with a Magnet
book.headinajar.written2.jar.no_hands.3: Hands: half speed, half damage, 200 FE a block or hit.

book.headinajar.written2.jar.charge.1:
A jar holds 100 kFE, full from the chair. As the jar you spend 2 FE/t: about 40 min. In your body, nothing.
At 0 powered modules stop; Armour Plating, Drill Bit, Magnet, Self-Righting Gyro and Night Lens still work.

The chair takes any.
book.headinajar.written2.getting_home.re: Goggles reach 48 blocks (Mk I), 160 (Mk II), 640 (Mk III) or the whole dimension (Quantum). Signal is full to half the range, gone at the edge; near another's powered Signal Jammer (16 blocks), 30%%. Going back into your body needs over 20%%.
A powered mast passes the link on: head to mast in goggle range, then mast to mast and on to the body within 96 blocks (192 for Mk II). Each mast costs 3%%. It draws 1 FE/t.
book.headinajar.written2.getting_home.co: Stranded as a jar? Press Courier in the jar menu, or type /headoffice courier. In 30 s your body, or its corpse, arrives beside you from anywhere, for 20 kFE (or all your charge). Step into a body with %1$s; a corpse takes a Suture Kit.
A jar module: while you are a jar, your standing body walks to you, 10 FE/t. Same dimension and loaded chunks only. It halts before lava, fire or a drop of over 3 blocks.
book.headinajar.written2.getting_home.su: With a Suture Kit: carrying your own head, hold %1$s for 3 s; or, as a jar, use it on your body or corpse. You stand up whole and dizzy. Modules and an empty jar come back, goggles and collar a little worn; a corpse gives your things back.
book.headinajar.written2.getting_home.co: A linked body that dies becomes a corpse with your armour and inventory, and you wake up in your head. Nothing hurts a corpse. Only you, and those you trust (/headoffice trust add), may use it to open it.

Incident 0119: No Suture Kit

As the jar, use the corpse. A Suture Kit on you or among its things is used at once. With no kit, the corpse opens its inventory so you can craft one. No body at all: the Body Printer.
book.headinajar.written2.getting_home.lo: Type /headoffice status. It prints your form, your link, where your head is (in you, set down, docked or in the satchel) and where your body is (standing or a corpse), each with dimension and coordinates, and your charge.
book.headinajar.written2.staffing.saw.1: Use it on a creature below a quarter of its health: the body stays up as a host. With a jar of any kind in your off hand, you keep the head and the body falls.
book.headinajar.written2.staffing.riding: As a jar, use a host to ride it. Linked and carrying your head, use it too: your body stays standing and the jar climbs on. The host goes where you look; fliers rise while you hold %1$s. %2$s attacks as the host does; %3$s dismounts.
book.headinajar.written2.staffing.sync.1: Sync grows 5%% a minute while you ride; on the first climb, each ring you hit adds 3%%. A body moves its own way from the first second: a flier flies, a spider climbs, a chicken floats. At 25%% its other traits work.
book.headinajar.written2.staffing.sync.2: At 50%% %1$s fires its ability, at 75%% %2$s the second (blaze, enderman, ravager). At 100%%: 10%% stronger.

book.headinajar.written2.staffing.upkeep: A host rots 2%% a minute and slows below half; at 0 it falls apart. Embalming Fluid makes it fresh and halves the rot for a day (20 minutes). Neural Lace, used at 50%% sync or more, stops it for good.
book.headinajar.written2.staffing.body_l: Use it to store the nearest host within 3 blocks, frozen: nothing rots inside. Use it again to let it out in front. It takes robot shells and your own mecha too.
book.headinajar.written2.staffing.robots:
Set a chassis down and use it as a jar to climb in. Shells never rot, are always synced and run on your jar's charge, 3 FE/t.
• Lunk: strong; tosses things
• Rover: fast, sprints; 9-slot hold
• Spider Walker: climbs, spins webs
book.headinajar.written2.mecha.gantry.1: Frame top left, modules in slots of their kind, then Assemble (10 kFE). The mecha stands on the Gantry, which charges it at up to 5,000 FE/t. Repair uses Mecha Plating, 20 HP each; Take apart puts the parts back in the slots.
book.headinajar.written2.mecha.frames.1:
One of each slot, except:
Hopper: torso 2, arms 2
Bulwark: back 2, torso 3, arms 2, sensor 2
Chimera: torso 3, arms 2, 3 Gene Ports
Wheelhouse (a car): no legs, back 2, torso 2
book.headinajar.written2.mecha.frames.2:
Skitter: no legs (climbs walls), torso 2, sensor 2
Kite: flies; no back, arms 2
Colossus: back 2, core 2, torso 5, arms 4, sensor 2
Executive: the same, plus 4 Gene Ports
The Wheelhouse cannot jump and is slow off-road.
book.headinajar.written2.mecha.frames.3: The Hopper, 60 HP: with Hydraulic Legs and a Galvanic Stack it walks and charges itself. The Colossus and Executive cannot fit a nether portal.
Board your mecha as a jar, or linked while carrying your head: use it. Only its owner and players they trust can. To get out, hold %1$s and %2$s for a second. Anyone with a body may ride in a Passenger Pod or a Wheelhouse seat.
%1$s works the left arm, %2$s the right. %3$s jumps, or fires jets in the air. %4$s fires the chosen utility, %5$s picks the next; add %6$s for the mecha's genes. %7$s opens the Cargo Hold.
book.headinajar.written2.mecha.gauges.1: Modules and moving make heat; rain and water shed it faster, the Nether slower. Above 85%% heat, everything works at 70%%; at 100%% the mecha vents for 5 s. Past 60%% load it slows; past 100%%, no jumping; past 125%%, no moving.
book.headinajar.written2.mecha.gauges.2:
Pilot Warnings
VENTING: nothing works, the steam scalds. Wait.
NO POWER: 30%% speed, no arms. Park on the Gantry.
OVERLOADED: unload the hold.
NO LEGS: fit walking legs.
book.headinajar.written2.mecha.mecha_mod: Legs that walk: Hydraulic Legs (set the Stride), Arachnid Legs (climb walls), Stilts (2-block steps), Hover Skirt (over water and lava), Lava Treads. Spring Heels, Sprint Servos, Aqua Fins and Anchor Clamps do not walk: only the Kite can use them.

Core: Galvanic Stack, Capacitor Bank; the Combustion Kernel, Bio-Reactor Core and Fusion Bottle burn fuel from the Cargo Hold.

Signal Booster and Bio-Scanner: fitted, they only draw power for now.
A Syringe draws a Blood Sample. The Centrifuge spins it into a DNA Fraction. The DNA Sequencer reads that into your library. The Gene Splicer makes a Serum Cassette; the Injection Rig puts it in you. All need power.
Syringe (30-60), Precision Syringe (60-90): blood.
Marrow Drill: skeletons, the Wither.
Oil Tap: iron golems.
Ecto Trap: vexes, allays, breezes, snow golems.
Leviathan Needle: bosses, Elder Guardian, Warden.
book.headinajar.written2.research.carrie: An auto-read (10 s) adds 15%% of the fraction's quality, shared among its creature's genes. Call the twelve bases yourself and it adds up to 25%%. At 30%% a gene is a Draft: half strength. 60%%: three quarters. 100%%: full.

book.headinajar.written2.research.splici: Up to three Draft genes, Bio-Gel and a glass bottle: 60 s. Stability starts at 100; genes and clashing pairs cost some, matching pairs add 10. Catalysts add: slime ball 5, amethyst 10, echo shard 20, nether star 40. Below 60 a serum may mutate.

Use a serum by hand on a host or a Chimera. Your body takes two serums of load 3 or less; a host, one up to 6; each Gene Port, one up to 8. Bodies and hosts may reject the wrong blood; mecha never. Active genes: %1$s and %2$s. Gene Wash clears you.
book.headinajar.written2.research.turret: Fit a Jarred Head: it fights hostiles within 16 blocks as the mob did. Skeletons need arrows in a chest beside or below; a creeper head blows up once. Pigs and cows have no job. 1 FE/t watching, 10 firing.
Up to nine Jarred Heads make FE from Nutrient Broth (bucket or pipe): each drinks 1 mB a second. Most make 10 FE/t; villagers 40, endermen 80, evokers 120. Five or more: +10%%. A Board Room Core puts one Dragon Head to work: 300.
book.headinajar.written2.research.socket: As a jar, use it to plug in. Scroll: face; hotbar keys: level 1-15, 0 off; %1$s: pulse; %2$s with %3$s: unplug. Alone, a zombie head pulses each second, a villager's climbs 8 levels, an enderman's fires when stared at.
Pay: an emerald a day, from a chest touching the mount; unpaid, half the bonus.

book.headinajar.written2.hr.faq.1:
Can I drink the saline? No.

Can a jar sit in the chair? No, but it can look at the panel.

Can my body take a portal? Only carrying its head, or over an Entangled Pair. A jar takes any.
book.headinajar.written2.hr.faq.2:
What if my jar breaks? A real death: modules, goggles and collar drop, and you respawn whole. The jar menu's Let Go button does this on purpose.
Can I saw a colleague? No. Nor bosses, named creatures, others' pets or hosts.
book.headinajar.written2.hr.incidents.1:
Incident 0311: Mecha wrecked

Below 10%% health, the Golden Parachute threw the pilot clear. A frame destroyed outright throws the pilot too, with a knock to the glass; about half its modules survive. Next: a Glass Patch.
book.headinajar.written2.hr.incidents.2:
Incident 0451: Head left in a fire

The glass lost a point a second until it broke: a real death. Next time: fetch it with the Head Satchel at once, or fit a Heat Shield.
book.headinajar.written2.hr.incidents.3:
Incident 0517: Body died while away

A body left standing was killed and lay down as a corpse. Next: the Courier, then a Suture Kit. A Life Sign Monitor shows its health.

HR sends its condolences.
